description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of  Exemption
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Public Utilities Commission exercising its regulatory powers under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act to issue certificates of exemption from licensing requirements. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the implementation and application of existing legislation (Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 as amended) through regulatory action. It does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
